## Diversity measurements in the Longitudinal Metastasis Cohort

### Libraries

We use lmerTest to perform the linear mixed models. It allows us to test if there is a significant change whilst controlling for different patients.

```{r libraries, echo = TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
theme_set(theme_cowplot())
library(lmerTest)
library(plyr)
library(reshape2)
library(data.table)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(forcats)
```

### Settings for the script

Now we will define things for this specific run. Most importantly this includes whether to apply a filter on gains or losses or to filter different sized segments.

```{r settings, warning=FALSE}
# Create a custom theme for plotting
plot_theme = theme_bw(base_size = 18) + theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
                                              panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# Make sink?
do_sink = F

# Wide plot
wide_width = 33

# Classifier
intercept = 0.432
gradient  = -0.000355

# Classifier margins (based on ±0.5 on beta0)
lower_int = 0.379
upper_int = 0.485

# y-label default
y_label_distance = "Divergence"

# Distance measure settings
distance_params = list("Type" = "MEDICC2", #MEDICC2 (not events, that's rle) or Alt_Status
                       "Use_altered_bins" = TRUE,
                       "Report_absolute" = FALSE,
                       "Normalise_by_bins" = FALSE)

# For supplementary analysis look at only gains and losses
cna_selection = c("Both", "Gains", "Losses")[1] # use the number to pick an option
if(!cna_selection %in% c("Both", "Gains", "Losses")) {stop("Invalid cna_selection parameter")}

# For supplementary analysis ask if we filter for segments of certain sizes
seg_size_filt = c("No_Size_Filter", "Large_Only", "Small_Only")[1]
if(!seg_size_filt %in% c("No_Size_Filter", "Large_Only", "Small_Only")) {stop("Invalid seg_size_filt parameter")}

# Plot dir
if(distance_params$Type=="Alt_Status") {
    
  y_label_distance = "Proportion of Aberrant Genome Subclonal"
  
  if(distance_params$Report_absolute) {
    
    plot_dir = paste0(distance_params$Type,"_absolutebinsalt=",distance_params$Report_absolute,"/")
    
  } else {plot_dir = paste0(distance_params$Type,"_usealtbinsonly=",distance_params$Use_altered_bins,"/")}

} else if(distance_params$Type=="Genetic") {
  
    plot_dir = paste0(distance_params$Type,"_normalisebybins=",distance_params$Normalise_by_bins,"/")
  
} else if(distance_params$Type=="Per_Gene") {
  
    plot_dir = paste0(distance_params$Type,"_usealtbinsonly=",distance_params$Use_altered_bins,"/")
  
} else if(distance_params$Type=="Breakpoints") {
  
    plot_dir = paste0(distance_params$Type,"/")
  
} else if(distance_params$Type=="Mean_Div_Size") {
  
    plot_dir = paste0(distance_params$Type,"/")
  
} else if(distance_params$Type=="Max_Div_Size") {
  
    plot_dir = paste0(distance_params$Type,"/")
  
} else if(distance_params$Type=="Salpie_divergence") {
  
    plot_dir = paste0(distance_params$Type,"/")
  
} else if(distance_params$Type=="Events") {
  
    y_label_distance = "rle Events"
    plot_dir = paste0(distance_params$Type,"/")
  
} else if(distance_params$Type=="MEDICC2") {
  
    y_label_distance = "MEDICC2 events"
    medicc2_analysis = read.csv("Pairwise_events_in_tree_LM_cohort.csv")
  
    plot_dir = paste0(distance_params$Type,"/")
  
} else {plot_dir = "./"}

plot_dir = paste0("Higher_Ploidies_",plot_dir)

dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = T)

# Make a sink
if(do_sink) {sink(paste0(plot_dir,cna_selection,"_",seg_size_filt,"_analysis_output.txt"))}
```

### Functions

Here we define functions used to measure distance. Firstly, we define `diff_state_dist` which is our measure of divergence, the number genomic bins that are different between two samples divided by total number of bins are aberrant (!=ploidy) in at least one sample.

The second function `pga_diff_dist`, measures the difference in PGA (as percentage points).

```{r functions, warning=FALSE}
# Here we define the distance measure we will use
source("../../Diversity_Metrics/DiversityMetrics.R")

# Used to calculate PGA percentage change
pga_change_dist = function(pre, post, abs = F, ploidy = 2) {
  
  # Calculate PGAs
  pre_pga  = length(which(pre!=ploidy)) / length(pre)
  post_pga = length(which(post!=ploidy)) / length(post)
  
  # Calculate increase in PGA
  output = ((post_pga - pre_pga) / pre_pga) * 100
  
  if(abs) {output = abs(output)}
  
  return(output)
  
}

# Simple difference calculation
pga_diff_dist = function(pre, post, abs = F, perc_not_frac = T, ploidy = 2) {
  
  # Calculate PGAs
  pre_pga  = length(which(pre!=ploidy)) / length(pre)
  post_pga = length(which(post!=ploidy)) / length(post)
  
  # Calculate increase in PGA
  output = (post_pga - pre_pga)
  
  if(perc_not_frac) {output = output * 100}
  
  if(abs) {output = abs(output)}
  
  return(output)
  
}

# Calculate union of PGAs
union_PGAs = function(x, y, ploidy = 2, fraction = T) {
  
  c = cbind(x, y)

  bins_ab = length(which(apply(c, 1, function(i) any(i!=ploidy))))
  
  if(fraction) {
    output = bins_ab / nrow(c)
  } else {output = bins_ab}

  return(output)
  
}

# We use this a lot so let's simplify it
ceilmax = function(x) {ceiling(max(x))}

# Easy coefficient extraction from linear models
getlmFit = function(lm) {
  
  coeff_info = summary(lm)$coefficients
  
  info = signif(c(coeff_info[,"Estimate"], coeff_info[2,"Pr(>|t|)"]), digits = 3)
  
  names(info) = c("Intercept", "Gradient", "p")
  
  return(info)
  
}

# Linear equation
yEquals = function(m, x, c) {
  (m*x)+c
}
```

### Preprocessing

Here we process the clinical data and the CNA calls. We read in the clinical data and then the calls. We also then choose to saturate calls of losses and gain thus that 0 and 1 losses are all treated as a loss and that all gains (3, 4, 5 etc.) are treated as being simply 'gained'. This means that a change from CN 2 to 5 is treated as being identical to 2 to 1 and 3 to 1, for instance.

```{r preprocessing, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Read in the patient ploidies
patient_plodies = read.table("cna_calls/patient_psit_solutions.txt",
                             header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)

# Round to nearest integer
patient_plodies$Ploidy = round(patient_plodies$PsiT)

# Manually add stage information
patient_stage = read.csv("stage.csv")

# Read in clinical/genomic data
clin_genomic = read.table("Table_S8_Fig3.LM_cohort_info_v2.csv", sep = ",",
                          header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Simplify the organs
clin_genomic$Organ[clin_genomic$Organ %in% c("Colon", "Rectum")] = "Colorectal"
clin_genomic$Organ[grep("lymph", clin_genomic$Organ)] = "Lymph"
clin_genomic$Organ[clin_genomic$Organ %in% c("Peritoneum", "Ovary", "Omentum")] = "Peritoneum"

# Split out the sample name
clin_genomic$Block  = unlist(lapply(strsplit(clin_genomic$Sample_Name, split = "-"), function(i) paste0(i[1:2], collapse = "-")))
clin_genomic$Region = unlist(lapply(strsplit(clin_genomic$Sample_Name, split = "-"), function(i) i[3]))

# Rename for legacy reasons
colnames(clin_genomic)[2] = "Patient_ID"
colnames(clin_genomic)[3] = "Organ_description"
colnames(clin_genomic)[5] = "Time_point"

# Read in call data
calls_list = lapply(1:nrow(clin_genomic), function(i) {
  
  # Sample info
  case   = clin_genomic[i,"Patient_ID"]
  sample = clin_genomic[i,"Sample_Name"]
  
  # Read that file in
  calls = read.table(paste0("cna_calls/",case,"_",
                            sample,"_500kb_GRCh38_cna_calls.txt"),
                     stringsAsFactors = F, check.names = F)
  
  
})

# Saturate gains and losses
if(distance_params$Type!="Genetic") {
  
  calls_list = lapply(1:length(calls_list), function(i) {
    
    m = calls_list[[i]]
    
    pp = patient_plodies[which(patient_plodies$Case==clin_genomic$Patient_ID[i]),"Ploidy"]
    
    loss.ind = which(m[,1] <= pp-1)
    
    gain.ind = which(m[,1] >= pp+1)
    
    if(cna_selection=="Both") {
  
      m[loss.ind,1] = pp-1
    
      m[gain.ind,1] = pp+1
      
    } else if(cna_selection=="Gains") {
      
      m[loss.ind,1] = pp
      
      m[gain.ind,1] = pp+1
      
    } else if(cna_selection=="Losses") {
      
      m[loss.ind,1] = pp-1
      
      m[gain.ind,1] = pp
      
    }
  
    return(m)
  
  })

}

# Filter on segment size?
if(seg_size_filt!="No_Size_Filter" & FALSE) {
  
  # Filter based on segment size, if neccesary
  calls_list = lapply(calls_list, function(m) {
    
    # What is decision
    if(seg_size_filt=="Large_Only") {rm_big = F}
    if(seg_size_filt=="Small_Only") {rm_big = T}
  
    # Remove big or small
    size_filt = 10*10^6
    
    # Collect the chromosomes
    chrs = do.call(rbind, lapply(strsplit(rownames(m), split = ":"), function(i) i[1]))
    
    # Collect the start and end positions
    start_end = do.call(rbind, lapply(strsplit(rownames(m), split = ":"), 
                                      function(i) unlist(strsplit(i[2], split = "-"))))
    
    # Make a full dataframe
    full_data = data.frame(chr = as.integer(chrs),
                           start =  as.integer(start_end[,1]),
                           end =  as.integer(start_end[,2]),
                           call = m[,1], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    
    # Run across the chromosomes
    processed_chrs = lapply(1:22, function(chr) {
      
      # Extract the data for the chromosome
      chr_call = full_data[full_data$chr==chr,]
      
      # Get the end position of the segments
      seg_ends = cumsum(rle(chr_call[,"call"])$lengths)
      
      # Calculate what that means for the starts
      chr_segs = data.frame(start = c(1, seg_ends[-length(seg_ends)] + 1), 
                            end = seg_ends)
      
      # Run across the segments and alter them if necessary
      per_segment = lapply(1:nrow(chr_segs), function(sn) {
        
        # Does it need to be corrected?
        alt_seg = chr_call[chr_segs$end[sn],"end"] - chr_call[chr_segs$start[sn],"start"] < size_filt
        
        # Opposite descision if rm_big is T
        if(rm_big) {alt_seg = !alt_seg}
        
        # Extract that part of the data
        extracted_seg = chr_call[chr_segs$end[sn]:chr_segs$start[sn],]
        
        # If it needs correction
        if(alt_seg) {extracted_seg[,"call"] = 2}
        
        return(extracted_seg)
        
      })
      
      # Collate
      processed_chr = do.call(rbind, per_segment)
      
    })
    
    # Collect results for each chromosome
    full_data_adj = do.call(rbind, processed_chrs)
    
    # Adjust the answer
    m_adj = m
    m_adj[,1] = full_data_adj[,4]
    
    return(m_adj)
    
  })

}

# Make them a matrix
calls_mat = do.call(cbind, calls_list)

# If we are doing the per gene analysis, calculate bin indexes
if(distance_params$Type=="Per_Gene") {
  
  # Get bins
  bins_pos = do.call(rbind, lapply(strsplit(rownames(calls_mat), 
                                            split=":"), function(i) unlist(strsplit(i, split="-"))))
  bins_pos = data.frame(chr   = bins_pos[,1],
                        start = as.numeric(bins_pos[,2]),
                        end   = as.numeric(bins_pos[,3]), stringsAsFactors = F)
  
  # Calculate gene indices 
  per_gene_bin_indexes = getGeneBinIndex(bins_pos)
  
}
```

Let's also make a matrix of "clonal" calls per block.

```{r clonal_cn_profiles_per_block, warning=FALSE}
# Get the codes for extraction
block_ids = unique(paste0(clin_genomic$Patient_ID,"_",clin_genomic$Block))

# Run through them and calculate clonal profile
clonal_block_profiles = lapply(block_ids, function(bid) {
  
  # Find the columns
  bcols = grep(bid, colnames(calls_mat))
  
  # Find the bins that disagree in at least one sample
  subclonal = apply(cbind(calls_mat[,bcols]), 1, function(i) any(i!=i[1]))
  
  # Extract the patient
  patient = strsplit(bid, split = "_")[[1]][1]
  
  # What's the ploidy?
  ploidy = patient_plodies$Ploidy[patient_plodies$Case==patient]
  
  # The answer is taking one profile and converting all the subclonal bins to the baseline ploidy
  clonal_profile = calls_mat[,bcols[1]]
  
  # Revert it
  clonal_profile[subclonal] = ploidy
  
  # Make it a matrix and name it
  clonal_profile = cbind(clonal_profile)
  colnames(clonal_profile) = bid
  
  return(clonal_profile)
  
})

# Combine
clonal_block_profiles = do.call(cbind, clonal_block_profiles)

# Add row names
rownames(clonal_block_profiles) = rownames(calls_mat)

# # Run through all comparisons
# comparisons = combn(ncol(clonal_block_profiles), m = 2)

# Make comparisons within each patient
patient_clonal_events_comparisons = lapply(unique(clin_genomic$Patient_ID), function(p) {
  
  # Patient cols
  pcols = grep(p, colnames(clonal_block_profiles))
  
  # Get the comparisons
  comparisons = combn(pcols, m = 2)
  
  # Do the comparison
  events = apply(comparisons, 2, function(c) {
    events_table = getEvents(sample_1 = clonal_block_profiles[,c[1]], 
                             sample_2 = clonal_block_profiles[,c[2]], 
                             bin_names = rownames(calls_mat))
    length(which(events_table$len>=10 & events_table$Change))
  })
  
  # Matching indices
  sample_1_inds = match(unlist(lapply(strsplit(colnames(clonal_block_profiles)[comparisons[1,]], split = "_"), 
                                      function(i) i[2])), clin_genomic$Block)
  sample_2_inds = match(unlist(lapply(strsplit(colnames(clonal_block_profiles)[comparisons[2,]], split = "_"), 
                                      function(i) i[2])), clin_genomic$Block)
  
  # Make a table of the comparisons
  res = data.frame(Patient = p, 
                   Sample_1 = colnames(clonal_block_profiles)[comparisons[1,]],
                   Sample_2 = colnames(clonal_block_profiles)[comparisons[2,]],
                   Organ_1  = clin_genomic$Organ[sample_1_inds],
                   Organ_2  = clin_genomic$Organ[sample_2_inds],
                   Desc_1   = clin_genomic$Organ_description[sample_1_inds],
                   Desc_2   = clin_genomic$Organ_description[sample_2_inds],
                   TP_1     = clin_genomic$Time_point[sample_1_inds],
                   TP_2     = clin_genomic$Time_point[sample_2_inds],
                   Events = events,
                   stringsAsFactors = F)
  
  return(res)
  
})
names(patient_clonal_events_comparisons) = unique(clin_genomic$Patient_ID)
```

### Calculate divergence

We then calculate divergence for all comparisons of samples and record the organ, timepoint, type of sample (primary and metastasis) and block id for each.

```{r read_call_data, warning=FALSE}
# Run through patients
patient_dists = lapply(unique(clin_genomic$Patient_ID), function(p) {
  
  # Get the patient ploidy
  pp = patient_plodies[patient_plodies$Case==p,"Ploidy"]

  # Patient ids
  pat_mat = calls_mat[,which(clin_genomic$Patient_ID==p)]
  
  # Corresponding clinical information
  clin_mat = clin_genomic[which(clin_genomic$Patient_ID==p),]
  
  # Run nested apply to get all distances
  col_col_dists = lapply(1:ncol(pat_mat), function(i) {
    
    # Get column
    col_a = pat_mat[,i]
    
    # Get the organ and timepoint
    organ_i = clin_mat[i,"Organ"]
    timep_i = clin_mat[i,"Time_point"]
    type_i  = clin_mat[i,"Organ_description"]
    month_i = clin_mat[i,"Month"]
    day_i   = clin_mat[i,"Days"]
    block_i = paste0(p,"_",clin_mat[i,"Sample_Name"])
    
    # Nest the other comparisons
    dists = lapply(1:ncol(pat_mat), function(j) {
      
      # Get column
      col_b = pat_mat[,j]
      
      # Get the organ and timepoint
      organ_j = clin_mat[j,"Organ"]
      timep_j = clin_mat[j,"Time_point"]
      type_j  = clin_mat[j,"Organ_description"]
      month_j = clin_mat[j,"Month"]
      day_j   = clin_mat[j,"Days"]
      block_j = paste0(p,"_",clin_mat[j,"Sample_Name"])
      
      # Get distance
      if(distance_params$Type=="Alt_Status") {
        d = diff_state_dist(x = col_a, y = col_b, 
                            only_alt_bins = distance_params$Use_altered_bins, 
                            absolute_number = distance_params$Report_absolute, ploidy = pp)
      }
      if(distance_params$Type=="Salpie_divergence") {
        d = calculateDivergence(rbind(col_a, col_b), ploidy = pp)
      }
      if(distance_params$Type=="Genetic") {
        d = genetic_distance(x = col_a, y = col_b, normalise_by_bin_number = distance_params$Normalise_by_bins)
      }
      if(distance_params$Type=="Per_Gene") {
        d = diff_state_dist(x = col_a[per_gene_bin_indexes], y = col_b[per_gene_bin_indexes], 
                            only_alt_bins = distance_params$Use_altered_bins, 
                            absolute_number = distance_params$Report_absolute, ploidy = pp)
      }
      if(distance_params$Type=="Breakpoints") {
        
        # Get positions through splitting row names
        pos = strsplit(rownames(pat_mat), split = ":")
        pos = lapply(pos, function(i) unlist(strsplit(i, split = "-")))
        
        # Make a dataframe for breakpoint comparison
        compare_df = data.frame(Chr = unlist(lapply(pos, function(i) i[1])),
                                Start = unlist(lapply(pos, function(i) i[2])),
                                End = unlist(lapply(pos, function(i) i[3])),
                                pat_mat[,c(i,j)], 
                                stringsAsFactors = F)
        
        # Make beginnings of chromosomes zero as expected by Salpie's script
        for(chr in 1:22) {
          compare_df[which(compare_df$Chr==chr)[1],"Start"] = 0
        }
        
        # Find breakpoints
        compare_df[,4:5] = convertToBreakpoints(compare_df[,4:5])
        
        # Make a score
        d = getScoreCN(compare_df, maxgap = 10^6, colnames(pat_mat)[c(i,j)])
        
      }
      if(distance_params$Type=="Mean_Div_Size") {
        
        # Get positions through splitting row names
        pos = strsplit(rownames(pat_mat), split = ":")
        pos = lapply(pos, function(i) unlist(strsplit(i, split = "-")))
        
        # Make a dataframe for breakpoint comparison
        compare_df = data.frame(Chr = unlist(lapply(pos, function(i) i[1])),
                                #Start = unlist(lapply(pos, function(i) i[2])),
                                #End = unlist(lapply(pos, function(i) i[3])),
                                pat_mat[,c(i,j)], 
                                stringsAsFactors = F)
        
        # Make a score
        d = get_diffLengths(compare_df, colnames(pat_mat)[c(i,j)], pp = pp)
        
      }
      
      if(distance_params$Type=="Max_Div_Size") {
        
        # Get positions through splitting row names
        pos = strsplit(rownames(pat_mat), split = ":")
        pos = lapply(pos, function(i) unlist(strsplit(i, split = "-")))
        
        # Make a dataframe for breakpoint comparison
        compare_df = data.frame(Chr = unlist(lapply(pos, function(i) i[1])),
                                #Start = unlist(lapply(pos, function(i) i[2])),
                                #End = unlist(lapply(pos, function(i) i[3])),
                                pat_mat[,c(i,j)], 
                                stringsAsFactors = F)
        
        # Make a score
        d = get_diffLengths(compare_df, colnames(pat_mat)[c(i,j)], pp = pp, max_size = TRUE)
        
      }
      
      if(distance_params$Type=="Events") {
        
        # Get positions through splitting row names
        bin_names = rownames(pat_mat)
        
        # Get events table
        events_table = getEvents(sample_1 = col_a, sample_2 = col_b, bin_names = bin_names)
        
        # Count the number of events, using a certain number of bins as the minimum needed to call
        d = length(which(events_table$len>=10 & events_table$Change))
        
      }
      
      if(distance_params$Type=="MEDICC2") {
        
        medicc2_patient = medicc2_analysis[medicc2_analysis$Patient==p,]
        
        # What is the MEDICC2 distance?
        d = medicc2_patient[medicc2_patient$Sample_A==gsub(paste0(p,"_"), "", block_i) & medicc2_patient$Sample_B==gsub(paste0(p,"_"), "", block_j),"Events"]
        
      }
      
      # Calculate absolute difference in PGA
      p = pga_diff_dist(pre = col_a, post = col_b, abs = T, perc_not_frac = F, ploidy = pp)
      
      # Calculate the fraction of bins aberrant in at least one sample of the pair (the denominator)
      pga_union = union_PGAs(col_a, col_b, ploidy = pp)
      
      # Give NA if it is the same comparison
      if(i<=j) {d = NA}
      if(i<=j) {p = NA}
      
      # Make the output a dataframe
      output = data.frame(dist = d,
                          Organ_i = organ_i,
                          Organ_j = organ_j,
                          TP_i = timep_i,
                          TP_j = timep_j,
                          Type_i = type_i,
                          Type_j = type_j,
                          Code_i = block_i,
                          Code_j = block_j,
                          Month_i = month_i,
                          Month_j = month_j,
                          Days_i = day_i,
                          Days_j = day_j,
                          pdiff = p,
                          union_pga = pga_union)
      
      return(output)
      
    })
    
    # Get those dists
    return(dists)
    
  })
  
  # Dist mat
  one_side_dist_mat = do.call(rbind, lapply(col_col_dists, function(i) do.call(rbind, i)))
  
  # One sided dist_mat for patient
  return(one_side_dist_mat)
  
})

# Name elements in the list
names(patient_dists) = unique(clin_genomic$Patient_ID)

# Also add it as a column
for(i in 1:length(patient_dists)) {
  
  # Add list name as a column
  patient_dists[[i]]$Patient = names(patient_dists)[i]
  
}

# Remove NAs
patient_dists = lapply(patient_dists, na.omit)

# Make into one massive df
cohort_dist_m = do.call(rbind, patient_dists)
```

### Calculate PGA and compare to divergence and WGD classifier

Added post-review.

```{r do_pga_wgd_analysis, fig.width=7}
# Run through patients
patient_pgas = lapply(unique(clin_genomic$Patient_ID), function(p) {
  
  # Get the patient ploidy
  pp = patient_plodies[patient_plodies$Case==p,"Ploidy"]
  
  # Patient ids
  pat_mat = calls_mat[,which(clin_genomic$Patient_ID==p)]
  
  # Corresponding clinical information
  clin_mat = clin_genomic[which(clin_genomic$Patient_ID==p),]
  
  # Run nested apply to get all distances
  pgas = lapply(1:ncol(pat_mat), function(i) {
    
    # Get column
    calls = pat_mat[,i]
    
    # Get the organ and timepoint
    organ_i = clin_mat[i,"Organ"]
    timep_i = clin_mat[i,"Time_point"]
    type_i  = clin_mat[i,"Organ_description"]
    month_i = clin_mat[i,"Month"]
    day_i   = clin_mat[i,"Days"]
    block_i = paste0(p,"_",clin_mat[i,"Sample_Name"])
    
    # Calculate PGA
    ploidy_norm_pga = length(which(calls!=pp)) / length(calls)
    
    # Could the number of segments
    n_segs = sum(unlist(lapply(1:22, function(chr) {
      
      chr_cn = calls[grep(paste0("^", chr,":"), rownames(calls_mat), perl = T)]
      
      chr_cn = chr_cn[chr_cn>=0]
      
      length(rle(chr_cn)$values)
      
    })))
    
    # Make a dataframe
    df = data.frame(Patient = p, 
                    Organ = organ_i, 
                    TP = timep_i, 
                    Desc = type_i, 
                    Code = block_i, 
                    Month = month_i,
                    Days_i = day_i,
                    PGA = ploidy_norm_pga,
                    nSegs = n_segs,
                    Ploidy = pp)
    
  })
  
  # Bring the PGA together
  do.call(rbind, pgas)
  
})

# Collapse together
patient_pgas = do.call(rbind, patient_pgas)

# Make ploidy as a factor
patient_pgas$Ploidy = as.factor(patient_pgas$Ploidy)

# Melt for per organ time point
summary_pga         = ddply(patient_pgas, .(Patient, Organ, TP), summarize, 
                            mPGA = mean(PGA), minPGA = min(PGA), maxPGA = max(PGA))

# Extract the divergence comparisons at the same timepoint
same_TPO_divergence = cohort_dist_m[cohort_dist_m$TP_i==cohort_dist_m$TP_j & cohort_dist_m$Organ_i==cohort_dist_m$Organ_j,]

# Calculate the mean of divergence
summary_divergence  = ddply(same_TPO_divergence, .(Patient, Organ_i, TP_i), summarize, Divergence = mean(dist))

# Create a 'tag' for merging
summary_pga$Tag = paste0(summary_pga$Patient,"_",summary_pga$Organ,"_",summary_pga$TP)

# Make another tag to merge
summary_divergence$Tag = paste0(summary_divergence$Patient,"_",summary_divergence$Organ_i,"_",summary_divergence$TP_i)

# Do the merge for the plotting
plot.df = merge(summary_pga, summary_divergence, by = "Tag")

# Make the timepoint category as a factor
plot.df$TP = as.factor(plot.df$TP)

# Make a plot similar to Figure 1
ggplot(plot.df, aes(x = mPGA*3217, y = Divergence, col = Organ, shape = TP)) + 
  geom_point(size = 2) + ylim(0,ceilmax(plot.df$Divergence)) + xlim(0,3217) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = Organ), method=lm, se=FALSE)

# Significance?
summary(lm(Divergence ~ mPGA, data = plot.df[plot.df$Organ=="Colorectal",]))
summary(lm(Divergence ~ mPGA, data = plot.df[plot.df$Organ=="Liver",]))

# Do the WGD axis
ggplot(patient_pgas, aes(x = nSegs, y = PGA, col = Ploidy)) + 
  ylim(0,1) + xlim(0,100) + geom_point() + 
  geom_abline(intercept = intercept, slope = gradient) +
  geom_abline(intercept = lower_int, slope = gradient, lty = "dotted") +
  geom_abline(intercept = upper_int, slope = gradient, lty = "dotted")


# Apply the classifier 
patient_pgas$WGD_class       = patient_pgas$PGA > (patient_pgas$nSegs*gradient) + intercept
patient_pgas$WGD_lower_bound = patient_pgas$PGA > (patient_pgas$nSegs*gradient) + lower_int
patient_pgas$WGD_upper_bound = patient_pgas$PGA > (patient_pgas$nSegs*gradient) + upper_int

# Add a category based on these T/Fs
patient_pgas$Class_with_confid = as.factor(apply(patient_pgas, 1, function(r) paste0(r["WGD_class"],"_",r["WGD_lower_bound"],"_",r["WGD_upper_bound"])))

# Rename these
levels(patient_pgas$Class_with_confid) = list(non_WGD_confid="FALSE_FALSE_FALSE", 
                                              non_WGD_ambig="FALSE_TRUE_FALSE", 
                                              WGD_ambig="TRUE_TRUE_FALSE",
                                              WGD_confid="TRUE_TRUE_TRUE")

# Find the per patient WGD classification in the style of Salpie
patient_WGD_class = unlist(lapply(unique(patient_pgas$Patient), function(p) {
  
  p_classes = patient_pgas$Class_with_confid[patient_pgas$Patient==p]
  
  wgs     = any(p_classes %in% "WGD_confid")
  
  non_wgs = any(p_classes %in% "non_WGD_confid")
  
  class   = "ambiguous"
  
  if(wgs) {class = "WGD"}
  if(non_wgs) {class = "non_WGD"}
  if(wgs & non_wgs) {class = "subclonal_WGD"}
  
  return(class)
  
}))

# Make the results a dataframe
per_patient_class = data.frame(Patient = unique(patient_pgas$Patient), 
                               WGD_class = patient_WGD_class)

# Per patient classification
patient_pgas$WGD_patient  = per_patient_class$WGD_class[match(patient_pgas$Patient, per_patient_class$Patient)]
cohort_dist_m$WGD_patient = per_patient_class$WGD_class[match(cohort_dist_m$Patient, per_patient_class$Patient)]

# Now do the same but just for primaries and mets
primary_wgd_clonality = unlist(lapply(unique(patient_pgas$Patient), function(p) {
    
    p_classes = patient_pgas$Class_with_confid[patient_pgas$Patient==p & patient_pgas$Desc=="Primary"]
    
    wgs     = any(p_classes %in% "WGD_confid")
    
    non_wgs = any(p_classes %in% "non_WGD_confid")
    
    class   = "ambiguous"
    
    if(wgs) {class = "WGD"}
    if(non_wgs) {class = "non_WGD"}
    if(wgs & non_wgs) {class = "subclonal_WGD"}
    
    return(class)
    
}))

# Now do the same but just for primaries and mets
metastasis_wgd_clonality = unlist(lapply(unique(patient_pgas$Patient), function(p) {
    
    p_classes = patient_pgas$Class_with_confid[patient_pgas$Patient==p & patient_pgas$Desc=="Metastasis"]
    
    wgs     = any(p_classes %in% "WGD_confid")
    
    non_wgs = any(p_classes %in% "non_WGD_confid")
    
    class   = "ambiguous"
    
    if(wgs) {class = "WGD"}
    if(non_wgs) {class = "non_WGD"}
    if(wgs & non_wgs) {class = "subclonal_WGD"}
    
    return(class)
    
}))

# Make the results a dataframe
per_patient_site_class = data.frame(Patient = rep(unique(patient_pgas$Patient), times = 2),
                                    Site = c(rep("Primary", times = length(unique(patient_pgas$Patient))),
                                             rep("Metastasis", times = length(unique(patient_pgas$Patient)))),
                                    WGD_class = c(primary_wgd_clonality, metastasis_wgd_clonality))
per_patient_site_class$Site = factor(per_patient_site_class$Site, levels = c("Primary", "Metastasis"))

# Make a plot
ggplot(per_patient_site_class, aes(x = WGD_class, fill = WGD_class)) +
  ylab("Count") +
  xlab("") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,16,by=4), labels = seq(0,16,by=4)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Ambiguous", "non\nWGD","Subclonal\nWGD","WGD")) +
  #ggtitle("WGD classification clonality by patient") +
  geom_bar(colour = "black") +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Site)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey", "#1F968B", "#FDE725", "#440154")) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "none",
        axis.text=element_text(size=24),
        text = element_text(size=24))
ggsave(filename = paste0(plot_dir,
                         cna_selection,"_",
                         seg_size_filt,"_site_WGD_classification.png"), 
       width = 7, height = 7)

# Prep individual sample correction preparation
ambig_to_WGD = unlist(lapply(unique(patient_pgas$Patient), function(p) {
    
    tab = table(patient_pgas[patient_pgas$Patient==p,"Class_with_confid"])
    
    # We trend towards WGD in ambigious cases if there are more _or equal_ number of confident WGD calls
    tab["WGD_confid"] >= tab["non_WGD_confid"]
    
}))

# Per patient decision
names(ambig_to_WGD) = unique(patient_pgas$Patient)

# Calculate the correction
corrected_classification = apply(patient_pgas, 1, function(i) {
  
  if(grepl("_ambig", i["Class_with_confid"])) {
    
    go_up = ambig_to_WGD[i["Patient"] == names(ambig_to_WGD)]
    
    if(go_up) {return(TRUE)} else {FALSE}
    
  } else {
    
    if("WGD_confid"==i["Class_with_confid"]) {return(TRUE)}
    
    if("non_WGD_confid"==i["Class_with_confid"]) {return(FALSE)}
    
  }
  
})

# Ambigious per sample classifications corrects
patient_pgas$WGD_class_corrected = corrected_classification
```

### Mean single timepoint divergence

Next, we calculate the *mean* divergence in each single time interval for each patient and we report the median value. This is provide a value for the general amount of divergence measured.

```{r mean_divergence_cohort_tps, warning=FALSE}
# Get single timepoint difference
summary_divergence_next_tp = cohort_dist_m[abs(cohort_dist_m$TP_i - cohort_dist_m$TP_j) == 1,]

# Make a code for the change
summary_divergence_next_tp$TP_diff_code = apply(summary_divergence_next_tp, 1, 
                                                function(r) paste0(sort(c(r["TP_i"], r["TP_j"])), collapse = "_"))

# Summarise
summary_divergence_next_tp = ddply(summary_divergence_next_tp, .(Patient, TP_diff_code), summarize, 
                                   meanDiv = mean(dist), minDiv = min(dist), maxDiv = max(dist),
                                   meanPGAdiff = mean(pdiff), minPGAdiff = min(pdiff), maxPGAdiff = max(pdiff))

# For looking up figures easily in text
manuscript_lookup = data.frame(summary_divergence_next_tp[,1:2], 
                               signif(summary_divergence_next_tp[,3:5], digits = 2),
                               signif(summary_divergence_next_tp[,6:8], digits = 2)*100)

print(paste0("Median mean timepoint divergence: ",signif(median(summary_divergence_next_tp$meanDiv), digits = 3)))
```

### Within organ divergence, primary and metastasis

Now we collapse this data and group the within timepoint, single organ divergences into primary and metastasis categories to investigate if metastatic deposits show a higher or lower level of within organ diversity than primary tumours. Here we can also see that we have much more data for liver metastases. 

```{r make_df_within_prim_mets, warning=FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6}
# Get only the heterogeneities within primaries and mets
within_prim_mets = cohort_dist_m[cohort_dist_m$TP_i==cohort_dist_m$TP_j & 
                                 cohort_dist_m$Type_i==cohort_dist_m$Type_j & 
                                 cohort_dist_m$Organ_i==cohort_dist_m$Organ_j,]

# Reorder those levels
within_prim_mets$Type_i = factor(within_prim_mets$Type_i, levels = c("Primary", "Metastasis"))
```

### Mixed model of within organ divergence, primary and metastasis

Of course, to correctly investigate this we need to perform some statistics. Therefore here we create a mixed model (`lmer`) of `Divergence ~ Metastasis` where we use each patient as a random effect to control for the fact that patients may show different total levels of divergence.

```{r mixed_model_primary_met, echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Do mixed modelling
res2b = lmer(dist ~ Type_i + (1 | Patient), 
             REML = TRUE, data = within_prim_mets)
print("Mixed model (1) - Primary and Metastasis using patients as random intercepts")
summary(res2b)

# P Values
p_value_prim_met_diff = signif(summary(res2b)$coefficients["Type_iMetastasis","Pr(>|t|)"], digits = 2)
p_value_line_height = max(within_prim_mets$dist)*1.1

# Plot divergences in Mets and Primary
ggplot(within_prim_mets, aes(x = Type_i, y = dist)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  ylab(y_label_distance) + xlab(NULL) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, aes(col = Type_i, 
    shape = Organ_i), size = 3) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("Primary" = "#029386", "Metastasis" = "#fc5a50")) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, ceilmax(within_prim_mets$dist), by=ceilmax(within_prim_mets$dist) * 0.5), 
                     labels=seq(0, ceilmax(within_prim_mets$dist), by=ceilmax(within_prim_mets$dist) * 0.5), 
                     limits = c(-0.1,max(1, p_value_line_height + 0.075))) +
  plot_theme + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 20)) + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, y = p_value_line_height, xend = 2, yend = p_value_line_height)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, y = p_value_line_height - 0.01, xend = 1, yend = p_value_line_height)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 2, y = p_value_line_height - 0.01, xend = 2, yend = p_value_line_height)) +
  annotate("text", label = paste0("p=",p_value_prim_met_diff), x = 1.5, y = p_value_line_height + 0.075, size = 5) +
  annotate("text", label = paste0("n=",table(within_prim_mets$Type_i)), x = 1:2, y = c(ceilmax(within_prim_mets$dist) * 0.9, 
                                                                                       ceilmax(within_prim_mets$dist) * 0.9), 
           size = 5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(17, 19, 15, 18, 4)) +
  labs(col = "Type", shape = "Organ (Panel C)")
ggsave(filename = paste0(plot_dir,
                         cna_selection,"_",
                         seg_size_filt,"_divergences_within_organs_categorised_by_primary_metastatsis.png"), 
       width = 7, height = 8.2)

# Plot divergences in Mets and Primary
ggplot(within_prim_mets, aes(x = Type_i, y = dist)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  ylab(y_label_distance) + xlab(NULL) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, aes(col = Type_i, 
    shape = Organ_i), size = 3) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("Primary" = "#029386", "Metastasis" = "#fc5a50")) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, ceilmax(within_prim_mets$dist), by=ceilmax(within_prim_mets$dist) * 0.5), 
                     labels=seq(0, ceilmax(within_prim_mets$dist), by=ceilmax(within_prim_mets$dist) * 0.5), 
                     limits = c(-0.1,max(1, p_value_line_height + 0.075))) +
  plot_theme + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 24), axis.text=element_text(size=24), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 24), legend.position = "none") + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, y = p_value_line_height, xend = 2, yend = p_value_line_height)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, y = p_value_line_height - 0.01, xend = 1, yend = p_value_line_height)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 2, y = p_value_line_height - 0.01, xend = 2, yend = p_value_line_height)) +
  annotate("text", label = paste0("p=",p_value_prim_met_diff), x = 1.5, y = p_value_line_height + 0.075, size = 7) +
  annotate("text", label = paste0("n=",table(within_prim_mets$Type_i)), x = 1:2, y = c(ceilmax(within_prim_mets$dist) * 0.9, 
                                                                                       ceilmax(within_prim_mets$dist) * 0.9), 
           size = 7) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(17, 19, 15, 18, 4)) +
  labs(col = "Organ")
ggsave(filename = paste0(plot_dir,

                         seg_size_filt,"_divergences_within_organs_categorised_by_primary_metastatsis_no_legend.png"), 
       width = 5.5, height = 8.2)

rownames(within_prim_mets) = NULL

```

### Compare divergence within colorectal and liver samples and between them

Now we would like to ask if there is a significant difference between divergence within liver and colorectal samples from the same patient and between them. For this we do not filter by timepoint. As we can see there are far fewer colorectal-colorectal comparisons compared to anything to the liver samples.

### ANOVA for difference between intra- and inter- organ variation

So now we ask if any of the categories have a significantly different mean using a simple one-way ANOVA (`aov`).

```{r compare_div_colorectal_liver, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
# Collapse the organ comparisons
organ_comparison = apply(cohort_dist_m, 1, function(r) {
  
  i = as.character(r[2])
  j = as.character(r[3])
  
  c = c(i,j)
  
  x = paste(c[order(c)], collapse = "|")

})

# Make a unique comparison
comparison_organs = data.frame(cohort_dist_m, Organ_Compare = organ_comparison)

# Subset only colorectal and liver
comparison_organs = comparison_organs[comparison_organs$Organ_Compare %in% 
                                      c("Colorectal|Colorectal", "Liver|Liver", 
                                        "Colorectal|Liver"),]
# comparison_organs$Organ_Compare = droplevels(comparison_organs$Organ_Compare)

# Here I will do an ANOVA first for divergence
print("An ANOVA for comparing divergence in colorectal and liver organs...")
anova_div = aov(dist ~ Organ_Compare, comparison_organs)
summary(anova_div)
tukey_divergence = TukeyHSD(anova_div)

# Make a look up table to plot p-values
p_value_coord = as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, strsplit(rownames(tukey_divergence$Organ_Compare), "-")), 
                              stringsAsFactors = F)

# Add in adjusted p values
p_value_coord$p_val_adj = tukey_divergence$Organ_Compare[,"p adj"]

# Now I will do an ANOVA first for PGA difference
print("An ANOVA for comparing difference in PGA in colorectal and liver organs...")
summary(aov(pdiff ~ Organ_Compare, comparison_organs))

# Make a ggplot
ggplot(comparison_organs, aes(x = Organ_Compare, y = dist)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + 
  ylab(y_label_distance) + xlab("") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, aes(col = Organ_Compare), size = 3) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("Colorectal|Colorectal" = "#5ca904", 
                               "Colorectal|Liver" = "#fec615", 
                               "Liver|Liver" = "#fc5a50")) + 
  ylim(-0.1,ceilmax(comparison_organs$dist)*1.1) + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = p_value_coord$V1[1], y = ceilmax(comparison_organs$dist)*0.85, 
                   xend = p_value_coord$V2[1], yend = ceilmax(comparison_organs$dist)*0.85)) +
  annotate("text", label = paste0("p=",signif(p_value_coord$p_val_adj[1], digits = 2)), x = 1.5, y = ceilmax(comparison_organs$dist)*(0.85 + 0.03), size = 4) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = p_value_coord$V1[2], y = ceilmax(comparison_organs$dist)*0.9, 
                   xend = p_value_coord$V2[2], yend = ceilmax(comparison_organs$dist)*0.9)) +
  annotate("text", label = paste0("p=",signif(p_value_coord$p_val_adj[2], digits = 2)), x = 2, y = ceilmax(comparison_organs$dist)*(0.9 + 0.03), size = 4) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = p_value_coord$V1[3], y = ceilmax(comparison_organs$dist)*0.95, 
                   xend = p_value_coord$V2[3], yend = ceilmax(comparison_organs$dist)*0.95)) +
  annotate("text", label = paste0("p=",signif(p_value_coord$p_val_adj[3], digits = 2)), x = 2.5, y = ceilmax(comparison_organs$dist)*(0.95 + 0.03), size = 4) +
  annotate("text", label = paste0("Tukey HSD test"), x = 2, y = ceilmax(comparison_organs$dist), size = 4) +
  annotate("text", label = paste0("n=",table(comparison_organs$Organ_Compare)), x = 1:3, y = c(-0.1, -0.1, -0.1), 
           size = 5) +
  plot_theme + theme(text = element_text(size = 24), axis.title.y=element_text(size=18), legend.position = "none") + labs(col = "Patient")
ggsave(filename = paste0(plot_dir,
                         cna_selection,"_",
                         seg_size_filt,"_non_timepoint_specific_colorectal_liver_comparison.pdf"), 
       width = 10, height = 6)

# Repeat for PGA difference
ggplot(comparison_organs, aes(x = Organ_Compare, y = pdiff)) + geom_violin() + 
  ylab("PGA difference") + xlab("") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, aes(col = Patient)) + ylim(-0.1,1) + plot_theme + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 24)) + labs(col = "Patient")
```

### Divergence found within same timepoint and in different timepoints

Now we want to know if divergence comparisons within timepoints are different from those not in the same timepoint. We now plot this simple category.

To assess this we simply ask what is the effect on divergence if a comparison is made within the same timepoint or not. We again do a mixed model (`lmer`) using the patient as a random effect.

```{r within_tp_across_tps, warning=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}

             REML = TRUE, data = within_tps_across_tps)

# print("Repeat of mixed model (2) but for PGA difference")
# summary(res2b)

# Still for plotting a pvalue

p_value_line_height = max(within_tps_across_tps$pdiff)*1.1

# Repeat for PGA difference
```

### Divergences between timepoint, including time normalised

Now we are interested in those divergences between single intervals across the patients both as a total value and also normalised by time (divergence month^-1^).

```{r time_normalised_analysis, warning=FALSE, fig.width=33, fig.height=6}
# Calculate date difference
patient_dists = lapply(patient_dists, function(p) {
  
  diffs = lapply(1:nrow(p), function(r) {
    
    patient = p[r,"Patient"]
    
    tp1     = p[r,"TP_i"]
    
    tp2     = p[r,"TP_j"]
    
    d1 = unique(clin_genomic[which(clin_genomic$Patient_ID==patient & 
                                   clin_genomic$Time_point==tp1),"Days"])
    
    d2 = unique(clin_genomic[which(clin_genomic$Patient_ID==patient & 
                                   clin_genomic$Time_point==tp2),"Days"])
    
    diff = d2 - d1
  
    diff = abs(diff)
    
    return(diff)
    
  })
  
  months_annot = lapply(1:nrow(p), function(r) {
    
    patient = p[r,"Patient"]
    
    tp1     = p[r,"TP_i"]
    
    tp2     = p[r,"TP_j"]
    
    m1 = unique(clin_genomic[which(clin_genomic$Patient_ID==patient & 
                                   clin_genomic$Time_point==tp1),"Month"])
    
    m2 = unique(clin_genomic[which(clin_genomic$Patient_ID==patient & 
                                   clin_genomic$Time_point==tp2),"Month"])
    
    ms = sort(c(m1, m2))
    
    month_annot = paste0("Month_",ms[1],"_to_",ms[2])
    
    return(month_annot)
    
  })
  
  steps_away = lapply(1:nrow(p), function(r) {
    
    tp1     = p[r,"TP_i"]
    
    tp2     = p[r,"TP_j"]
    
    steps = abs(tp2 - tp1)
    
    return(steps)
    
  })
  
  treatment_prior_to_most_recent_tp = lapply(1:nrow(p), function(r) {
    
    patient = p[r,"Patient"]
    
    tp1     = p[r,"TP_i"]
    
    tp2     = p[r,"TP_j"]
    
    max_tp  = max(tp1, tp2)
    
    prev_tr = unique(clin_genomic[which(clin_genomic$Patient_ID==patient & 
                                        clin_genomic$Time_point==max_tp),"Treatment_in_previous_interval"])
    
    return(prev_tr)
    
  })
  
  p$Difference_time = unlist(diffs)
  
  p$Difference_points = unlist(steps_away)
  
  p$Treatment_prior_recent_tp = unlist(treatment_prior_to_most_recent_tp)
  
  p$Month_annotation = unlist(months_annot)
  
  return(p)
  
})

# Collapse the full data set
patient_dists_mat = do.call(rbind, patient_dists)

# Remove ugly row names
rownames(patient_dists_mat) = NULL

# Add id for the comparison itself
patient_dists_mat$Compare_Code = paste0(patient_dists_mat$Code_i,"_",patient_dists_mat$Code_j)
cohort_dist_m$Compare_Code     = paste0(cohort_dist_m$Code_i,"_",cohort_dist_m$Code_j)

# Merge them together
patient_dists_mat = merge(patient_dists_mat, cohort_dist_m[,c("WGD_i","WGD_j","WGD_compare","Compare_Code")], 
                          by = "Compare_Code", sort = FALSE)

# Write it out
write.table(patient_dists_mat, 
            file = paste0(plot_dir,cna_selection,"_",seg_size_filt,"_lm_cohort_divergence_comparison.txt"), 
            sep = ",", row.names = F, quote = F)

# Remove anything that is not a comparison of one timepoint to the next
patient_dists_next_tp = lapply(patient_dists, function(p) p[p$Difference_points==1,])

# Collapse and normal
patient_dists_next_tp = do.call(rbind, patient_dists_next_tp)

# Normalised divergence over time
patient_dists_next_tp$Divergence_by_time = patient_dists_next_tp$dist / 
                                           ((patient_dists_next_tp$Difference_time / 365) * 12)

# Time comparison
patient_dists_next_tp$Timepoint_comparison = apply(patient_dists_next_tp, 1, 
                                                   function(r) paste0(sort(r[4:5]), collapse = "_"))

# Add space instead of underscore
patient_dists_next_tp$Month_annotation = gsub("_", " ", patient_dists_next_tp$Month_annotation)

# Make month annotation a factor
patient_dists_next_tp$Month_annotation = as.factor(patient_dists_next_tp$Month_annotation)

# The order first month
level_order = order(as.numeric(unlist(lapply(strsplit(levels(patient_dists_next_tp$Month_annotation), 
                                                      split = " "), function(i) i[2]))))

# Reorder them levels
patient_dists_next_tp$Month_annotation = factor(patient_dists_next_tp$Month_annotation, 
                                                levels(patient_dists_next_tp$Month_annotation)[level_order])

# Make y-lim flexible
ymax = ceilmax(patient_dists_next_tp$dist)

# Do ggplot2
ggplot(patient_dists_next_tp, aes(x = Month_annotation, y = dist)) + geom_violin() + 
  ylab(y_label_distance) + xlab("Timepoint comparison") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, aes(col = Treatment_prior_recent_tp)) + ylim(-0.1,ymax) + 
  facet_grid(. ~ Patient, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") + plot_theme + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) + labs(col = "Treatment in interval")
ggsave(filename = paste0(plot_dir,cna_selection,"_",seg_size_filt,"_divergences_between_timepoints_total.pdf"), 
       width = wide_width, height = 6)

# Add one for PGA difference
ggplot(patient_dists_next_tp, aes(x = Month_annotation, y = pdiff)) + geom_violin() + 
  ylab("PGA difference") + xlab("Timepoint comparison") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, aes(col = Treatment_prior_recent_tp)) + ylim(-0.1,1) + 
  facet_grid(. ~ Patient, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") + plot_theme + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) + labs(col = "Treatment in interval")

# Make y-lim flexible
ymax = ceilmax(patient_dists_next_tp$Divergence_by_time*10)/10

# Do ggplot2
ggplot(patient_dists_next_tp, aes(x = Month_annotation, y = Divergence_by_time)) + geom_violin() + 
  ylab("Proportion of Aberrant Genome Subclonal (per month)") + xlab("Timepoint comparison") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, aes(col = Treatment_prior_recent_tp)) + ylim(-0.01,ymax) +
```

### Average change in PGA across timepoints

Here we process the data to calculate percentage of the genome aberrated (PGA) and to compare from one timepoint to the next whether this goes up or down and record the difference. Here is PGA in one sample is 0.41 and in the next it is 0.43, we would report it as going up by 0.02 * 100 (2). We average this for each timepoint and report the median of the averages across the cohort.

```{r pga_change_timepoints, warning=FALSE}
######################################
### Task: Calculate changes in PGA ###
######################################

# Run through patients
patient_pga_change = lapply(unique(clin_genomic$Patient_ID), function(p) {
  
  # Get the patient ploidy
  pp = patient_plodies[patient_plodies$Case==p,"Ploidy"]
  
  # Patient ids
  pat_mat = calls_mat[,which(clin_genomic$Patient_ID==p)]
  
  # Corresponding clinical information
  clin_mat = clin_genomic[which(clin_genomic$Patient_ID==p),]
  
  # Run nested apply to get all distances
  col_col_dists = lapply(1:ncol(pat_mat), function(i) {
    
    # Get column
    col_a = pat_mat[,i]
    
    # Get the organ and timepoint
    organ_i = clin_mat[i,"Organ"]
    timep_i = clin_mat[i,"Time_point"]
    type_i  = clin_mat[i,"Organ_description"]
    month_i = clin_mat[i,"Month"]
    day_i   = clin_mat[i,"Days"]
    block_i = paste0(p,"_",clin_mat[i,"Sample_Name"])
    
    # Nest the other comparisons
    dists = lapply(1:ncol(pat_mat), function(j) {
      
      # Get column
      col_b = pat_mat[,j]
      
      # Get the organ and timepoint
      organ_j = clin_mat[j,"Organ"]
      timep_j = clin_mat[j,"Time_point"]
      type_j  = clin_mat[j,"Organ_description"]
      month_j = clin_mat[j,"Month"]
      day_j   = clin_mat[j,"Days"]
      block_j = paste0(p,"_",clin_mat[j,"Sample_Name"])
      
      # Get distance
      d = pga_diff_dist(pre = col_a, post = col_b, abs = T, perc_not_frac = T, ploidy = pp)
      
      # Give NA if it is the same comparison
      if(timep_i!=(timep_j-1)) {d = NA}
      
      # Take the entry of the two which has the most recent timepoint and ask if it was treated in the interval
      #   Non-sequential comparisons will be removed by na.omit due to above statement
      treated = clin_mat[c(i, j)[which.max(c(timep_i, timep_j))],"Treatment_in_previous_interval"]
      
      # Make the output a dataframe
      output = data.frame(pdiff = d,
                          Organ_i = organ_i,
                          Organ_j = organ_j,
                          TP_i = timep_i,
                          TP_j = timep_j,
                          Type_i = type_i,
                          Type_j = type_j,
                          Code_i = block_i,
                          Code_j = block_j,
                          Month_i = month_i,
                          Month_j = month_j,
                          Days_i = day_i,
                          Days_j = day_j,
                          Treated = treated)
      
      return(output)
      
    })
    
    # Get those dists
    return(dists)
    
  })
  
  # Dist mat
  one_side_dist_mat = do.call(rbind, lapply(col_col_dists, function(i) do.call(rbind, i)))
  
  # One sided dist_mat for patient
  return(one_side_dist_mat)
  
})

# Name elements in the list
names(patient_pga_change) = unique(clin_genomic$Patient_ID)

# Also add it as a column
for(i in 1:length(patient_pga_change)) {
  
  # Add list name as a column
  patient_pga_change[[i]]$Patient = names(patient_pga_change)[i]
  
}

# Remove NAs
patient_pga_change = lapply(patient_pga_change, na.omit)

# Make into one massive df
pga_change_m = do.call(rbind, patient_pga_change)

# Calculate average per patient and timepoint difference
per_patient_tp_pga_change = lapply(unique(pga_change_m$Patient), function(p) {
  
  # Take patient
  pat_m =  pga_change_m[pga_change_m$Patient==p,]
  
  # What timepoints are there in this patient?
  diff_tps = unique(paste0(pat_m[,"TP_i"],"_",pat_m[,"TP_j"]))
  
  # Warn against splitting of interval annotation because they aren't ordered
  if(length(diff_tps)!=max(c(pat_m[,"TP_i"], pat_m[,"TP_j"])) - 1) {stop("Order of TP annotation has split a category")}
  
  # Run through the tps
  per_tp = lapply(diff_tps, function(t) {
    
    # Calculate mean
    mean_pga_change = mean(pat_m[paste0(pat_m[,"TP_i"],"_",pat_m[,"TP_j"])==t,"pdiff"])
    
    # Was this interval treated?
    treated = unique(pat_m[paste0(pat_m[,"TP_i"],"_",pat_m[,"TP_j"])==t,"Treated"])
    
    # Catch for error 
    if(length(treated)!=1) {stop("Multiple treatment in interval statements for same timepoint")}
    
    # Return treatment status and mean pga change
    out = data.frame(Mean_PGA_change = mean_pga_change, 
                     Treated = treated, Interval =t, 
                     Patient = p)
    
    return(out)
    
  })
  
  do.call(rbind, per_tp)
  
})

# Collapse into a full table
per_patient_tp_pga_change = do.call(rbind, per_patient_tp_pga_change)

# What is the median change in PGA in all time intervals
print(paste0("Median mean increase in PGA (+ / -): ",
             round(median(per_patient_tp_pga_change$Mean_PGA_change), digits = 1)))

if(do_sink) {sink()}

# Variable ylim max
ylim_max = round(max(per_patient_tp_pga_change$Mean_PGA_change) + 10, digits = -1)

# Make a histogram
ggplot(per_patient_tp_pga_change, aes(x = Treated, y = Mean_PGA_change)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = median(per_patient_tp_pga_change$Mean_PGA_change)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.5) + ylab("Mean PGA change in interval") + ylim(0,ylim_max) + 
  xlab("Treated in interval") + 
  ggtitle("Mean PGA change between all sequential timepoints", subtitle = "(horizontal line displays whole cohort median)") + 
  annotate("text", label = paste0("n=",table(per_patient_tp_pga_change$Treated)), x = 1:2, y = c(35, 35), 
           size = 5) +
  plot_theme + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
ggsave(filename = paste0(plot_dir,
                         cna_selection,"_",
                         seg_size_filt,
                         "_mean_PGA_change_timepoints_treatment.png"), 
       width = 9, height = 7)
  
```

### Mean PGA across time

```{r timeline_pga, warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
# Days from first sample timepoint
days = clin_genomic$Days

# Add days
patient_pgas$Days_since_first_sample = days[match(patient_pgas$Code, paste0(clin_genomic$Patient_ID,"_",clin_genomic$Sample_Name))]

# Melt for per organ time point
summary_with_days         = ddply(patient_pgas, .(Patient, TP, Days_since_first_sample), summarize, 
                                  mPGA = mean(PGA), minPGA = min(PGA), maxPGA = max(PGA))

# Add info on whether it is going up or down
summary_with_days$change_in_next = unlist(lapply(1:nrow(summary_with_days), function(r) {
    
    p = summary_with_days[r,"Patient"]
    
    t = summary_with_days[r,"TP"]
    
    d = summary_with_days[which(summary_with_days$Patient==p &  summary_with_days$TP==(t+1)),"mPGA"] - summary_with_days[r,"mPGA"]
    
    if(length(d)==0) {d = NA}
    
    return(d)
    
}))

# Print percentage points change
print(paste0("Percentage points change: ",round(mean(summary_with_days$change_in_next, na.rm = T)*100, digits = 2)))

ggplot(summary_with_days, aes(x = Days_since_first_sample+1, y = mPGA*100)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  ylab("Mean PGA at timepoint") +
  xlab("Day of time course") + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 100, by=25), labels=seq(0, 100, by=25), limits = c(0,100)) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans='log10', breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Patient)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text=element_text(size=24),
        text = element_text(size=24))
ggsave(filename = paste0(plot_dir,
                         cna_selection,"_",
                         seg_size_filt,
                         "_mean_PGA_timepoints_patients.png"), 
       width = 7, height = 8.2)
```

### Comparing PGA of post-timepoint 1 samples to the mean of the previous

```{r rate_pga_change, warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
# Run through each sample and compare to meanPGA of previous interval and record the number of days and treatment
diff_PGA_mPGA_prev = lapply(1:nrow(patient_pgas), function(i) {
  
  # Get the row
  r = patient_pgas[i,]

  # What's the timepoint?
  t = r[,"TP"]
  
  # What's the patient?
  p = as.character(r[,"Patient"])
  
  # If it's the first the answer is NA
  if(t==1) {
    
    output = NA
    
  } else {
    
    # What the meanPGA of the previous timepoint
    mPGA_prev_tp = summary_with_days[summary_with_days$Patient==p & summary_with_days$TP==t-1,"mPGA"]
    
    # What's the difference of this sample to that mean
    change_mPGA  = r[,"PGA"] - mPGA_prev_tp
    
    # Number of days since start in the previous timepoint
    start_days  = summary_with_days[summary_with_days$Patient==p & summary_with_days$TP==t-1,"Days_since_first_sample"]
    
    # Number of days since start in this timepoint
    end_days    = summary_with_days[summary_with_days$Patient==p & summary_with_days$TP==t,"Days_since_first_sample"]
    
    # What's the difference?
    diff_days   = end_days - start_days
    
    # Was there treatment in that interval?
    treated     = per_patient_tp_pga_change[per_patient_tp_pga_change$Patient==p & per_patient_tp_pga_change$Interval==paste0(t-1,"_",t),"Treated"]
    
    # Output this as the row as input to this loop
    output      = r
    
    # Attach this additional information
    output$PGA_change_prev = change_mPGA
    output$Interval        = paste0(t-1,"_",t)
    output$Interval_days   = diff_days
    output$Interval_treat  = treated
    
  }
  
  return(output)
  
})

# Gather and remove the NAs
diff_PGA_mPGA_prev = do.call(rbind, diff_PGA_mPGA_prev)
diff_PGA_mPGA_prev = na.omit(diff_PGA_mPGA_prev)

# Normalise by time
diff_PGA_mPGA_prev$PGA_change_time = diff_PGA_mPGA_prev$PGA_change_prev / ((diff_PGA_mPGA_prev$Interval_days / 365.25) * 12)


# Do some stats
lmerRes = lmer(PGA_change_time ~ Interval_treat + (1 | Patient), 
               REML = TRUE, 
               data = diff_PGA_mPGA_prev)

# Extract the p-values
p_values = signif(summary(lmerRes)$coefficients[,"Pr(>|t|)"], digits = 2)
ests     = signif(summary(lmerRes)$coefficients[,"Estimate"], digits = 2)

# Make the plot
ggplot(diff_PGA_mPGA_prev, aes(x = Interval_treat, y = PGA_change_time)) + 
  geom_violin() + geom_boxplot(width=0.1) + 
  ylim(-0.1,0.07) +
  ylab("PGA change per month") +
  xlab("Treatment") +
  ggtitle("Difference in PGA from mean \n of previous timepoint per month") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = "dotted") +
  annotate("text", label = paste0("Estimate=",ests[1]," (p=",p_values[1],")"), x = 1, y = 0.06, 
           size = 4) +
  annotate("text", label = paste0("Estimate=",ests[2]," (p=",p_values[2],")"), x = 2, y = 0.06, 
           size = 4) +
  theme_cowplot() + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
ggsave(filename = paste0(plot_dir,
                         cna_selection,"_",
                         seg_size_filt,
                         "_rate_pga_change_month.png"), 
       width = 7, height = 7)

```
